content.short: Ambisafe bridges blockchain and traditional finance.
content.description: Ambisafe operates three products: Tabla, Orderbook, and Unicorn Tokenization Corp. Tabla serves as a platform to issue security tokens and manage a blockchain-based cap table, allowing issuers to issue securities in compliance with jurisdictional requirements. Orderbook is a decentralized exchange for primary and secondary trading of security tokens. Unicorn Tokenization Corp is a fund of pre-IPO tokenized and fractionalized derivatives. Ambisafe has tokenized more than 15 companies and lowered the minimum investment to as little as $1 (UTC), including SpaceX and Neuralink.
